name: Nenavizhu svoju vajfu-strimershu
source:
Get the streamer's attention at any cost before someone else does. Write comments, chat, and make donations to your waifu, but do not dare to hate her!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988620/Nenavizhu_svoyu_vajfustrimershu/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
不惜一切代价抢在其他人之前吸引主播的注意。给你的老婆写评论、聊天、捐款，但不敢恨她！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988620/Nenavizhu_svoyu_vajfustrimershu/]Steam[/url]]
